aiExplanation: This function calculates the **minimum time to visit all points** by computing the **Chebyshev distance** (chessboard distance) between consecutive points. It iterates through each point starting from the second one, calculating the time for each step as the **maximum of the absolute differences** in x and y coordinates between the current and previous point. This works because in chessboard movement, moving diagonally or horizontally/vertically all take 1 time unit, so the longest axis determines the total time. The function returns the total accumulated time needed to visit all points in the given order.
